kills.property: Burning an amount _value must decrease totalSupply by exactly _value, not by a fixed constant.
kills.change_summary: Replace `totalSupply -= _value;` with `totalSupply -= 1;` so burning decreases totalSupply by a fixed amount rather than by _value.

kills.property: Calling freezeAccount(target, true) must make frozenAccount(target) true.
kills.change_summary: Negate the freeze flag written to the mapping.

kills.property: After the owner freezes an account, any transfer involving that account reverts (because frozenAccount is actually updat
kills.change_summary: Delete the statement that updates frozenAccount so the mapping is never changed.

kills.property: Calling freezeAccount(t, true) must freeze exactly the given target account t (frozenAccount(t) becomes true).
kills.change_summary: Write to frozenAccount[msg.sender] instead of frozenAccount[target].
